subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu text commands (/stop, /new, /status) no longer bypass queue during active agent run (3.8 regression)

question: Which Feishu text slash commands should bypass the same-chat queue during an active run?
rationale: Current code proves the report is only partially fixed, but `/new` is stateful session-lifecycle behavior and automation should not choose that permanent command-lane policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Narrow Safe Bypass
options.body: Keep `/stop` on the abort control lane, add tested immediate handling for read-only `/status`, and document or separately decide `/new`.

options.title: Bypass All Authorized Command-Only Text
options.body: Route all authorized whole-message Feishu slash commands to a command lane, accepting the need for stronger state and ordering tests around stateful commands.

options.title: Split Remaining Behavior
options.body: Treat the abort portion as fixed, track `/status` and `/new` under the broader Feishu slash-command work, and update docs if stateful commands intentionally stay queued.

recommendation.title: Narrow Safe Bypass
recommendation.body: Keep `/stop` on the abort control lane, add tested immediate handling for read-only `/status`, and document or separately decide `/new`.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice sits at the command-turn fast-path and Feishu sequential-lane boundary that this owner recently touched.
